The distinguished four-space has no commuting extension; uniqueness of maximal containment outside it follows from the degree-one line and degree-two coset. Counts follow by disjoint Gaussian subspace stratification. Full F2 RREF enumeration of all 29,212 subspaces and F3 enumeration in dimensions 0,1,2 independently matched predictions. Computation is a check, not an infinite-field proof.

value.rationale: The originating article singles out this seven-dimensional example as the smallest class-three CB algebra, but leaves its abelian-subalgebra lattice unquantified. Complete maximal-subalgebra geometry (a line bundle plus a distinguished maximal ideal), explicit incidence dimensions, and a complete closed finite-field dimension distribution are natural structural and arithmetic invariants. The unique maximal-containment phenomenon makes a nontrivial Gaussian count possible and can support studies of abelian-subalgebra incidence and commutativity for CB algebras; the work is not a parameter rename or arbitrary finite slice.
